subject: Req113 — final determination and recommendation to reclassify role
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Req113 — recommendation to pause and re-scope

Team,

After conducting the final round debriefs and reviewing the evaluation matrix (attached), I recommend we do not extend an offer for req113 in its current scope (Staff ML infra). The candidate was strong technically, but feedback was split on domain experience and the panel raised concerns about comp band pressure and ramp timeline.

Key points:
- Candidate (Priya R.) scored high on systems design but lower on infra domain experience (SLO/serving runtimes).
- Compensation band for Staff/Principal would require a band exception or stretch offer; current headcount plans do not support this.
- Hiring timeline and org priorities shifted — infra team is reprioritizing capacity work to Jan–Mar.

Recommendation: Pause req113 and reclassify to an IC Sr. ML/Inference role (req113a) with a revised scope and target comp band L5-L6. If approved, we can retain candidate pipeline (with TalentPrime) and re-engage candidates with the re-scoped JD.

Ive attached the evaluation matrix and comp-band comparison for context. Requesting committee confirmation/objections by Tuesday EOD (Dec 22). If no objections, I will close the req and open reclassification next week.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Hiring Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: req113-eval-matrix.pdf (application/pdf, 220KB); comp-band-comparison-2026.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 48KB)

Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Req113 — recommendation to pause and re-scope

Agree with Olga. My read matches — strong candidate but mismatch against immediate team needs and comp posture.

If we keep the req open at Staff band wed either: a) stretch budget or b) slow other hires. Neither is ideal given Q1 deliverables. Recommend pause + reclassify. Happy to sign off.

-Vivek

Thanks for the write-up, Olga. A couple of quick clarifying Qs before I sign off:
1) Was an offer ever verbally floated to the candidate, or is this before any formal ask? I want to make sure we close the loop with Talent/Agency appropriately.
2) If we reclass to Sr (L5-L6), are we comfortable with the expected time-to-productivity and what compensation target will look like (range)?

If the answers are: no offer yet, and comp fits the L5-L6 band, Im inclined to approve the reclassification and pause. If you can confirm, I will mark this as approved from People ops side.
